title: What Can You Do Before and After a Boat Trip in Funchal?
description: Most of central Funchal is a short walk from the marina: the cathedral, the market, the old town and the cable car to Monte. Here is what fits each trip time.
heroAlt: Funchal cable car cabins rising over the old town rooftops, seen from a marina pontoon in the morning

funchal old town before a boat trip
